document_kind: Read-only, source-backed proposed implementation plan; no candidate source built or executed
main_findings: Current GUI54976 and continuous64899 are separate immutable variants. Full GUI task/runtime proof does not demonstrate their combination.

Both current component entries call native_app_component_entry, which clears common extension BSS/workspaces and calls original TTS bootstrap. Composing both entries would reset live state and repeat original bootstrap.

Continuous code64899 occupies nearly the fixed64KiB region. Only637 bytes remain; new UI/control code needs a separately linked layout, new import addresses and new patch plan. Remaining3MiB reservation is not automatically executable or accepted package space.
Native source START is36B721; actual STOP is36AF75 and is asynchronous. STOP0 return ignores native message-send result and cannot acknowledge completed cleanup.

Current music_runtime_boot(channel8,36,source_priority) is an explicit guest call in the test fixture, not performed by the loader entry. New boot glue must make this call from guest context only after initialization prerequisites.

Existing source_worker is already the sole coordinator owner for channel8. Reuse its bounded pending/event loop to serialize new control commands; UI launch must return without waiting for native synchronous audio START or asynchronous STOP.

Current runtime_cancel does not add a local UI admission gate to the stream. A new gate must prevent configuration/START/event17/F1 from rearming audio after a local stop until a later explicit Start.

Original cleanup hook can observe full3B9DFC return, but source_worker_completed currently filters only its configured channel8. Source9 WAV needs an ownership/generation-specific completion branch and original native node cleanup before UI completion.
Source9/8 private actor identity does not reserve native queues against stock writers. Reject foreign occupancy; a physical exclusivity mechanism and navigation coexistence remain unresolved.

The completed full-scoped GUI background proof leaves foreground/touch/display/input queue callback and task/module cleanup unproven. Hardware App/direct-phone/acceptedVPM-SIG evidence is still absent.

full_GUI_runtime.meaning: Two native GUI worker TCBs, original event/mutex/condition paths, singleton controller return and full resident memory/task guards. No foreground/input callback, physical IRQ, sound or cleanup.

implementation_placements.implementation: Adapt stream gate/callback/consumer in new copies. Under AV mutex5523DF/5523FD atF50098 set/clear local armed state coherently with session/queue epoch. Locally disarmed configuration and START reject before original acceptance; event17 may not restart private queue while disarmed; F1 enqueue and selected consumer recheck admission/session/epoch. Unlock AV mutex before cancel/post/wait. Leave exact original syntax/state validation and other endpoints intact.
implementation_placements.Start_semantics: Start arms the native receive route and awaits real phone AVDTP configuration/START/media. It does not emit phone audio, fake START callbacks or write SEP state. If a phone remains in actual streaming state after local Stop, a later local Start needs a characterized AV-locked resume operation: coherent bound session/state8, source cleanup complete, no busy lease, then media_queue_begin and new queue_epoch. Otherwise remain ARMED awaiting a real remote suspend/start or reconnection. This new live-session resume boundary is not proven by current tests.
implementation_placements.Stop_semantics: Disarm first, invalidate private queued epoch under established lock ordering, then cancel native source; retain protocol/configuration and module state as appropriate. Packet discard while phone still streams is a local stop, not AVRCP pause or successful remote suspend. Explicit remote pause control requires a separately recovered protocol API and is outside this minimal candidate.

review_conclusion: The next concrete implementation is a new singlylinked bootstrap plus one existing home-icon toggle, bounded source-actor command path, source9 ownedWAV lifecycle test branch, and channel8 local admission/stop completion adapter. Start/Stop completion must be guest-driven and generation-backed. This is a feasible offline candidate design, not implemented code, physical App/music or goal completion.
new_build_gate: No hardware transfer is proposed. The128KiB code plan is a candidate layout inside the documented3MiB DLL reservation only; actual executable memory permission and acceptedVPM-SIG remain independent unmet contracts.
